create.name: Starhawk
create.bio:
Starhawk is a writer and teacher of earth-based spirituality, best known for The Spiral Dance, her 1979 guide to Goddess religion and modern witchcraft, which helped shape the contemporary Pagan revival. She is one of the founders of Reclaiming, a Pagan tradition that now has communities in North America, Europe, Brazil and Australia, and for decades she has helped lead its large public Spiral Dance ritual at Samhain in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Her approach treats the earth as sacred and ritual as a way of changing both the self and the world, and she weaves magic, myth and practical action together. She has written or co-written thirteen books, among them Truth or Dare, The Earth Path, and novels such as The Fifth Sacred Thing. Alongside her spiritual teaching she trains people in permaculture design through Earth Activist Training, which she founded, and much of her writing, podcasting and teaching links ecology and spirituality with community organising. She lives in San Francisco and travels widely to teach and speak.

books.description: An early book mixing ritual, chants and stories with her thinking on power and community, showing how she brings magic and spiritual practice to bear on wider change.

sprint.held: Owner decision needed (6 Nov 2026): her site presents her as 'Author. Activist. Teacher. Witch.', her blog archive is largely activist and political (election posts, WTO, gender politics, 'A Brief Guide to Hexing'), her podcast is 'The Movement We Need', and her current YouTube series is 'Transforming the War Cult'. Her Goddess and ritual teaching is central too, so this may or may not count as political-centred under the brief. Held rather than skipped so the owner can decide.
